title: Compound Angle Formulas
text:
The compound angle formulas for cosine are:

$$\cos(A + B) = \cos A \cos B - \sin A \sin B$$
$$\cos(A - B) = \cos A \cos B + \sin A \sin B$$

Notice the sign difference!

title: Match the Pattern
text:
Our expression has a PLUS sign between the terms:
$$\cos 80° \cos 20° + \sin 80° \sin 20°$$

This matches: cos(A - B) = cos A cos B + sin A sin B

hintAnswer: cos(A - B) = cos A cos B + sin A sin B
title: Correct Identity
text: The expression matches the cosine subtraction formula.
